approval.confirmation_reference: The user authorized uninterrupted best-in-plan execution without repeated routine approvals.
approval.scope: One immutable zero-training readiness using one C01 fit sequence, the three frozen V2 geometry checkpoints and the sealed endpoint-observability sidecar. Zero C07/C08/C09/C10, optimizer, checkpoint selection, graph or M-TARE.

corrective_of.evidence: V2 geometry passed but safe relation TP was zero; the follow-up audit found 15.7% of physical window positives lacked support at both attached endpoints while more than 95% of physical identities were observable somewhere.
corrective_of.scope: Keep causal input, 32 slots, geometry checkpoints, six loss families, splits and C07 gates. Add Teacher-only endpoint validity and a learned deployment evidence head; reset relation layers only.

estimated_cost.compute: One RTX 5090 D process; 42 tests, three CPU checkpoint-transfer audits and one C01 real-row forward/backward.

failure_policy: Any input, transfer, mask, sparse-objective, gradient, invariance, determinism or resource failure stops before training. Do not alter data, Teacher band, model input, gates or thresholds inside the run.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.boundary: The model has exactly 2635631 parameters in 197 tensors; only 742149 parameters in 64 relation/evidence tensors are trainable.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.gradient: Every trainable tensor has a finite nonzero gradient and every frozen tensor has no gradient after one real-batch backward pass.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.interfaces: Exactly 42 old/new unit tests pass and the student input remains five causal normalized range/valid scans plus relative odometry only.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.invariance: Repeated inference is bit exact; query permutation error <=3e-5 and target permutation/endpoint reversal loss errors <=1e-6.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.mask: Toggling a hidden positive attachment changes no loss, while the sparse-cardinality objective remains bit exact.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.real_batch: The fixed C01 row contains 11 active primitives, 17 observed endpoints, supported connections and hidden connections; all six losses and their mean are finite.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.resources: Peak CUDA allocation <=4 GiB, wall time <=0.5 h and output <=0.05 GiB; zero optimizer/checkpoint write/C07+/graph/M-TARE reads.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.transfer: All three V2 checkpoints transfer exactly 133 frozen geometry/temporal tensors and reset exactly 64 relation/evidence tensors.

purpose: Prove that the corrected window-observability supervision reaches the reversal-aware sparse relation loss and that frozen V2 geometry can support relation-only corrective training.
retention: Keep card/spec, test log, three transfer reports, real-row contract, losses, gradient/invariance checks, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: One fixed C01 source sequence selected before model execution because it contains both supported and hidden physical endpoint connections.
sampling.rule: Read row 5 only from S01_flat_tree_small_C01__c1_mixed in the fit partition. It has 11 active primitives, 17 supported endpoints, 8 supported and 3 hidden undirected positive attachments.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated Cano assets; redistribution remains subject to upstream licensing.
raw_sources: sealed P1a corrected C01 causal LiDAR shard
three frozen V2 selected geometry checkpoints

split.fit: One C01 row is read for readiness only.
split.historical_pollution_audit: The failed V2 run supplies frozen geometry/temporal weights only. Its relation weights, predictions and C07 outputs are not transferred.
split.selection: C07 zero rows read; no threshold or checkpoint is selected.
split.strict_test: C09/C10 and all formal M-TARE worlds remain unread.

teacher.labels: Swept primitive parameters, presence, temporal visibility, attachment, disconnected overlap and endpoint observability.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is run. Deployment must use the learned endpoint-evidence probability; graph edges remain traversal-only after C07/C08 pass.
teacher.source: P1b construction labels plus the sealed per-window endpoint ray-support sidecar at the pre-registered 0.25 m band.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: Endpoint support bits are loss-side Teacher targets only. World identity, construction graph, TNG, absolute pose, endpoint truth and future frames never enter forward.
teacher.valid_mask: A physical attachment between two matched primitives enters relation loss only if both endpoints are observed. Hidden physical connections are unknown, never negative. Unmatched sparse queries remain valid negative regularization.
